items.html: Now, it was explained above, the order of the clothing of all the Partzufim for the purpose of this coupling, which is for the sake of ZON, and it was explained there that the Netzah of Arich Anpin clothes within Aba, and the Hod of Arich Anpin within Ima, and the Yesod of Arich Anpin becomes the secret of the Daat that decides between Aba and Ima, being in their two Yesodot, for the right half of the Yesod of Arich Anpin is placed in the Yesod of Aba, and its left half is placed in the Yesod of Ima.
